adversarial_findings.design_case: Job J checkpoints and establishes target high-water H. A new source S then registers as H+1 and publishes its visitor link. During the later KV scan and compatibility checks, shopper reads retain the captured projection (or null, which is accepted) while S's visitor link is visible. The scan captures S in an extra plan. Registered-source cleanup correctly excludes H+1, so S has no J receipt. Extra-object cleanup nevertheless calls /identity/erase/object with only J; the absent-receipt branch rotates S and deletes its fresh behavior/intent/transfer/forwarding state. The target cutoff therefore does not protect this fresh registered source. Ordered publication is not an atomic cross-key read snapshot, and no authoritative cutoff check exists at the destructive fallback.
adversarial_findings.required_rework: Make v5 generic object cleanup generation-safe: a newly registered or otherwise unresolved generation must be refused or explicitly excluded before destructive cleanup, using authoritative evidence rather than KV projection coherence. Preserve exact source receipts, the target cutoff and v1-v4 behavior; do not weaken compatibility checks or silently claim historical discovery completion.
adversarial_findings.smallest_regression: Extend the existing grouped controller fixture with one schedule: pause after target begin/high-water, admit/link a new source, expose its visitor link while serving the captured shopper projection, then resume the job through extra cleanup.
